title: Tool availability check runtime event payload (Rust track, v0.2 probe shape)
description: FUS-TOOL-PROBE (2026-08-13; P0-A-2): single probe face snapshot — complete/incomplete cover ALL 23 main-agent work tools. The old available/unavailable/degraded/unprobed catalog shape is removed on the v0.2 track (v0.1 keeps it for replay-only); reasons are stable neutral statements, never availability judgment words. gate_decision is an internal mechanical field — producers currently emit pass (reserved for future mapping).

probe_scope.description: 0ac S2 (2026-09-13, IMMEDIATE_RESULT_DELIVERY_AND_STREAMING_RETRIEVAL_DESIGN §5): main_agent_work_tools = 既有 23 工具面单探针；retrieval_family = 检索族三类硬设施在位读数（浏览器 / 搜索引擎 / web 通道），run 起始一次，与工具面探针各自成事件。

retrieval_enabled.description: 0ac S3① (2026-09-13, 设计 §9/§10.2): the run-level independent retrieval enablement gate reading carried by every retrieval_family probe (projection.rs retrieval_family_payload emits it unconditionally; false ⇒ all three family members read absent with a neutral reason). Schema widened 2026-09-20 review-fix batch: the field existed in the producer since 0ac S3① but was missing here, so every journal carrying the probe failed full replay validation (unexpected key).

retrieval_family.description: 0ac S2 (2026-09-13, 设计 §5): 检索族三类硬设施在位读数 —— 如实汇报（FP-2 精神），不教学、不给建议；present=false 必须带 reason。probe_scope=retrieval_family 时必填。

reason.description: present=false 时的如实原因（真实类别，非壳码）。

detail.description: present=true 时的在位读数（可达域名/版本等中性事实）。
